description: Rochester, NY – Today, Joe Morelle announced that the United Association of Plumbers, Pipefitters, and Service Techs Local 13 has endorsed his candidacy for the 25th Congressional District. Local 13, which covers all of Monroe County, has served our community for over 125 years and represents over 1,200 members.
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY JOE MORELLE FOR CONGRESS bottom of page
title: Plumbers Endorse Morelle - Joe Morelle for Congress
